case_name: Yash Pal And Another vs State Of Haryana And Others

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Yash Pal and another (husband, wife, plaintiff)
parties.respondent_defendant: State of Haryana and others (wife's family, defendant)

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioners seek direction to protect their life and liberty. Petitioner No. 1 is already married but wants to marry petitioner No. 2 after obtaining divorce.

legal_principles.principle: Privacy is a facilitative tool to achieve dignity and freedom.
legal_principles.held: The ability of the individual to protect a zone of privacy enables the realization of the full value of life and liberty.

legal_principles.principle: The destruction by the state of a sanctified personal space is violative of the guarantee against arbitrary state action.
legal_principles.held: The destruction by the state of a sanctified personal space whether of the body or of the mind is violative of the guarantee against arbitrary state action.

legal_principles.principle: The autonomy of the individual is the ability to make decisions on vital matters of concern to life.
legal_principles.held: Autonomy of the individual is the ability to make decisions on vital matters of concern to life.

legal_principles.principle: The guarantee of equality is a guarantee against arbitrary state action.
legal_principles.held: It prevents the state from discriminating between individuals.

outcome.final_order: Common verdict made on both petitions and LPA.
